correctness.rationale: For a fixed ell-AP and adjacent occupied pair, union sizes ell+2-j give hypergeometric probabilities p_(ell+2-j). The pair-overlap counts are N2=(ell-1)(n-ell+1), N1=2ell T-2q-2N2 and N0=(n-1)T-N1-N2, because only consecutive step-one APs contain a full adjacent pair and interval endpoints appear in q APs each. This yields the exact covariance. Dividing by p_ell gives quadratic F(k), with F(n)=0; F(k)/(n-k) is affine. Its endpoints at k=ell,n-1 are ((ell-1)D)/(n(n-ell)) and (2E)/(n(n-ell)); integer decomposition n=(ell-1)q+r proves D,E>0 for n>=ell+2. n=ell+1 separate calculation gives 2(ell-1)/(ell+1)^2. R=k-Y gives reversed sign. For k=ell=3, n>=5, the R=1,2,3 conditional AP means are 1,0,positive, invalidating stronger regression monotonicity. Independently enumerated all fixed subsets for 56 (n,ell,k) triples with 4<=n<=9, exact-rational agreement and positivity. Finite checks corroborate analytic all-n proof.
